basics.name: EJ Fox
basics.label: Design Engineer & Creative Technologist
basics.summary: Design engineer and creative technologist who ships under pressure. I transform complex information into clear interactive visuals and have fun doing it. My work combines journalistic curiosity with an addiction to trying new things—from NBC’s election graphics to experimental embedding interfaces. I want to make things no one has seen before with smart, kind people.

work.name: Arizona State University NEWSWELL
work.summary: Lenfest AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program, with support from OpenAI and Microsoft
highlights: Built an AI-assisted tool that automates ad and content layout for hyperlocal print newspapers
Gave an Ignite talk on the work at ASU’s National Journalism + AI Accelerator (January 2026)
Demoed the tool to OpenAI, Microsoft, ProPublica and the Boston Globe at the program’s demo day

work.name: Independent Consultant
work.summary: Select Clients: GitHub • NBC News • CBS News • Washington Post • New York Times • Carnegie Mellon • Stamen
highlights: Specializing in tight-deadline projects that require fast iterative sprints and user testing – especially things no one has ever done before
Helped CBS News prototype their broadcast touchscreen app, analyzed newspaper front pages for the NY Times, and helped make geographic visualizations with the geniuses at Stamen for Meta
Comfortable working across design and engineering teams and with a wide array of technology stacks, adapting to everything from fresh startups to enterprise workflows
Published 50+ Observable notebooks, YouTube livestreams, and blog posts of in-progress work, experiments, and methodology - working in public at every opportunity
